liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): This soundboard copy lacks Not Fade Away, so the reviewer considers it incomplete [12]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Reviewer usually skips this song but replayed this version [22]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd80-10-11 s1t01 Dire Wolf**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd80-10-11 s1t02 Dark Hollow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd80-10-11 s1t03 Rosalie McFall**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd80-10-11 s1t04 Cassidy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd80-10-11 s1t05 Deep Elem Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd80-10-11 s1t06 Monkey & The Engineer**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd80-10-11 s1t07 China Doll**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd80-10-11 s1t08 Heaven Help The Fool**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-10-11.142012.sbd.smith.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): soundboard; 33 songs; 211 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1980-10-11.155431.sbd.1gen.miller.t.flac16**: soundboard; 31 songs; 211 min [3]
- **gd1980-10-11.156343.akg-se5-wiseman-miller-clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 31 songs; 197 min [5]
- **gd80-10-11.acoustic-sbd.windsor.323.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 45 min; rated 4.8/5 by 20 [9]. Said about its sound: The acoustic-set soundboard sounds excellent; Very clean recording, comparable in quality to the Reckoning album; Possibly the best-sounding of the Archive's 1980 acoustic sets, with a strong vocal mix and prominent Jerry [14][16][21][22]
- **gd80-10-11.sbd-acoustic.windsor.clevenger.fix-323.6198.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 45 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [10]

## Around the show

- The missing portion of this soundboard is the part featuring guitarist John Cipollina [13]
- John Cippolina guested from Not Fade Away through One More Saturday Night [1]
- The first set was acoustic [1]
- John Cippolina joined the band from Not Fade Away through One More Saturday Night [3]
- Reviewer places this acoustic set among many strong Warfield acoustic sets [14]
- The first set is stronger than the opening shows of the Warfield run, suggesting the band had adjusted [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-10-11.142012.sbd.smith.miller.clugston.flac2496**: transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Matt Smith; source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Cassettes > 1st generation cassettes > Matt Smith's 2nd generation cassettes; Transfer Info: 2nd generation cassettes (Nakamichi… [1]. Also: Made from second-generation cassettes supplied by Matt Smith, among other sources [1]
- **gd1980-10-11.155431.sbd.1gen.miller.t.flac16**: transferred by Transfer and Mastering by Charlie Miller  January 15, 2022; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550) > Cassette (Sony TC-D5M/TDK SA-C90) [3]. Also: Patch sources came from Scott Clugston, Matt Smith, Jeff Knudsen and Ron Ellner; Joe B. Jones provided pitch correction settings; the transfer went from 24-bit/96k down to 16-bit/44.1k [3]
- **gd1980-10-11.156343.akg-se5-wiseman-miller-clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG SE-5E mics with CE-1 cardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII 90) [5]. Also: Ron Ellner's Nakamichi 700 source supplies crowd sound, openings of Dire Wolf and China Cat Sunflower, and a patch in Space into Not Fade Away [5]
- **gd80-10-11.acoustic-sbd.windsor.323.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [9]
- **gd80-10-11.sbd-acoustic.windsor.clevenger.fix-323.6198.shnf**: source: Soundboard->Reel->PCM->DAT->CDR [10]. Also: Bob Clevenger normalized the levels using EAC and DART Pro 98 [10]
